programme.desc: Mía y Miguel se reconcilian y le dice que siempre soñó con volver a estar así con él. Rocco le insinúa a Giovanni que ante la careta de machito que tiene, se esconde un gay. Roberta le dice a José que se está haciendo daño.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía se reconcilia con Vico y Celina. Vico enfrenta a Pilar porque se entera de que ella causó su separación de Giovanni. Miguel regresa a la escuela y todos descubren que volvió con Mía. Tomás y Giovanni creen que Roberta y Diego andan a escondidas.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma sigue desconfiando de Reverte. Santos le dice a Teo que si ya no se siente bien termine con José. Roberta se entera de que Diego está diciendo que pasaron la noche juntos. Alma vuelve a ver a Octavio abrazando a Roberta y le exige que la suelte.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma explota ante Reverte y le pide a Roberta tener cuidado con él. Lola entra al cuarto de Santos en la noche y lo besa, pero él la confunde con Lupita. Gastón descubre a Mía y a Miguel besándose.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel le explica a Mía que Gastón lo obligó a hacer un trabajo con Romina. Lupita le dice a Santos que la que lo besó fue Lola. Roberta le encarga a Rocco que la grabe cuando se le declare a Diego. Teo le pide a Jose que lo acompañe a ver a su mamá.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lupita recrimina a Santos por rechazar a Lola y decirle que era por ella. Teo no resiste ver a su mamá mal y sale corriendo. Lola le dice a Lupita que la detesta. Roberta exhibe un video para demostrar que Diego y ella no tienen relaciones sexuales.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel no acepta que Franco le pague la colegiatura para que deje de ser becado; Teo le reclama a José por decirle a Gastón que tiene asma para que no lo aceptara en el equipo de fútbol; Roberta se disculpa con Diego por lo del video.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta insulta a Iñaki por inventar que Diego hablaba mal de ella. Teo le da clases de equitación a Raquel; León rechaza tajantemente la idea de Diego de dedicarse a la música. Martín Octavio quiere platicar con Roberta sobre su cuadro.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El profesor Reverte lleva a Roberta a conocer niños de la calle y así aprenda a valorar lo que tienen en la vida. Alma le reclama a Reverte por haberse llevado a Roberta sin permiso. Iñaki se vuelve el técnico de RBD.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina le asegura a Mía que Sol es una buena persona. León lleva a cabo sus planes para lograr que Diego abandone la banda. Alma descubre que Octavio tiene un hermano gemelo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego convoca a sus compañeras para que hagan pruebas y así encontrar a las suplentes de Roberta y Lupita, debido a que ellas decidieron dejar el grupo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Vico decide hacer la audición para ser la nueva vocalista de la banda. Lola le confiesa a Roberta el gran amor que siente por Santos. Mía logra que Sol no se quede en la banda.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Luján sufre al saber que Teo decidió terminar su relación. Diego se encela al ver a Roberta besándose con Nikki. Alma sospecha que Octavio no es el buen hombre que dice ser. Gastón lleva a cabo sus planes para deshacerse de Luján.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lola sufre al saber que Santos jamás se enamorará de ella. Diego se molesta al saber que Roberta le robó sus canciones. Gastón lleva a cabo sus planes para hacerle la vida imposible a Luján.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Giovanni tiene muchos problemas para escribir una carta dirigida al director. Jose se enoja con Roberta porque no le contó que Teo la engaña con Raquel. Roberta planea destruir Rebelde. Mía logra que Selina le confiese su plan.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego y sus amigos hacen un plan para que Roberta vaya a su departamento. Sol vierte pegamento en el cabello de Mía. Roberta rechaza a Iñaki porque ella no quiere tener novio. Mía les muestra a sus amigas que recuperó su cama en el dormitorio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Luján quiere renunciar a la escuela. Alma se preocupa cuando encuentra una carta de Roberta donde le dice que se irá por unos días, pero Roberta ha decidido irse de manera definitiva. Roberta se deprime al recordar su solitaria infancia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía contrata a un estilista para que le quite el pegamento que Sol le echó en el cabello. Diego le confiesa a Iñaki que pasó la noche con Roberta. Mía cobra venganza y le juega una broma pesada a Sol.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pascual trata de arruinar el concierto de RBD en beneficio de los niños de la calle. Roberta se las ingenia para dejar la escuela incomunicada y estropear las intenciones de Pascual. Roberta no quiere contarle a su mamá que Diego la secuestró.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta es descubierta en la dirección por Pascual. Jose descubre que Roberta le escribió a su tutor. Alma no está segura quien es el padre de Roberta. Roberta discute con Luján porque quiere dejar el colegio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía no quiere irse a París con su papá, pues no quiere dejar a Miguel y a la banda. Miguel trata de convencer a Mía de viajar con su padre. El padre de Mía habla con Pascual para que Alma deje de darle clases a su hija.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma le hace creer a Pascual que él podría ser el padre de Roberta. Pascual encuentra el celular que estaba desaparecido. Mia decide ayudar a Roberta y se juntan todos los miembros originales de la banda para el concierto.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: RBD tiene un concierto donde deben demostrar su talento. Todos los alumnos de la Elite Way participan en el concierto lo que los pone nerviosos, contentos y entusiasmados. Alma sigue pensando que Pascual puede ser el padre de Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: León lleva a la policía al concierto de RBD para impedir que su hijo cante y Roberta presenta a León como patrocinador de su presentación.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía se despide de sus amigas, pues debe viajar con su padre, ella les pide que le entreguen una carta a Miguel. Giovanni busca a Victoria para preguntarle si sale con Rocco. Roberta comienza a llevarse bien con el nuevo novio de su mamá.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Sabrina recrimina a Miguel porque no aceptó cantar para una niña enferma. Diego culpa a Roberta de todo lo que le pasa. Diego y Tomás le piden trabajo al papá de Giovanni en su carnicería. Vico descubre que su papá se gasta su dinero en apuestas.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Iñaki está emocionado por la carta que le dio Roberta. Vico está muy triste y Rocco llega a consolarla. Teo habla con José para decirle que su mamá quiere verla a ella, pero ella no quiere. Celina está muy nerviosa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pascual va a buscar a su hija y los persigue por toda la casa. Miguel va al hospital a buscar a Sabrina, donde ella está muy bien y hace labor social. Giovanni pide ayuda a su mamá, pero cuando llega, se avergüenza de ella mientras Diego la defiende.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma le propone a Martín trabajar como su bailarín y corista. Mía y Miguel se extrañan mutuamente. Pascual habla con Alma sobre la reunión de los alumnos en la que estaban desnudos, pero él tiene problemas con Galia porque se pone celosa de Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Vico le pide a Celina más tiempo para poder pagarle el dinero que le debe. Rocco les pregunta a Diego y a Giovanni si saben algo del papá de Vico. Una mujer llega de manera abrupta a ver a León para exigirle por su hijo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: La mamá de Diego regresa para verlo, pero León no se lo permite. Vico empeña la pulsera de la amistad que le regaló Mía para conseguir dinero y dárselo a su papá.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Vico le inventa a Rocco que es amante de un anciano y ella es la que le da dinero; Sol se enoja al no ser elegida como modelo para una campaña; Alma acusa a Reverte de homosexual por acosar a Iñaki; Diego amenaza con matar a la profesora Julia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gandía le aclara a Alma que Reverte no es homosexual. Alma le confirma a Gandía que Roberta no es su hija. León amenaza a Mabel con lastimar a Diego si se atreve a buscarlo. Diego le exige a Roberta que le diga cómo supo del enema que le hicieron.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El padre de Sabrina quiere hacerles una entrevista al grupo RBD, lo que pone a los chicos muy felices, pero ella lo que busca es acercarse más a Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego se enoja con Tomás al descubrir que fue él quien dijo lo de su enema. Celina recrimina a Sol por alejar a Alan de ella. Diego confiesa que extraña a su mamá. Teo golpea a Gastón por maltratar a Jose. Rocco cree que Vico consume drogas.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Las chicas están en una reunión con la maestra Fátima, la cual dice que ella está para dirigirlas en su equipo de porristas sustituyendo a Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta hace un plan para que José tenga una cita en el departamento de Diego y demostrarle a Teo que ya lo olvidó. Mía discute con su padre y él le dice que cambie esa cara pesada.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Sol le dice a Ana que si no ha visto a Celina, aprovecha también para decirle que ella está para servir en la escuela entonces le pide una orden de alimentos larga.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El papá de Rocco por fin conoce a su novia Victoria y le dice que se ve mejor sin sus lentes obscuros, ya que es de mala educación tenerlos puestos y más si no hay rayos del sol.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina gana un concurso en el que participa en la radio y Pascual le dice que hay un tipo que pregunta por ella y resulta que es el cantante Ricardo Montaner.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Victoria llora en un pasillo de la escuela, a lo lejos. Mía se da cuenta y le dice que le cuente qué es lo que le pasa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta entra al examen de Diego para distraer a la maestra de Literatura y la maestra le dice que es mentira lo que dice.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía se molesta con Miguel porque no usa el traje que le regaló y prefiere ir con una chamarra y jeans, sin importarle que van a la ópera.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gastón enfrenta a Roberta debido a que él, con el pretexto de buscar a José, irrumpe en su dormitorio a horas inapropiadas con violencia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Todos los chicos le donan ropa a Sabrina para los niños del hospital, Jack emocionado le dice a Miguel que ya quiere volver a ver a Sabrina, el dinero que recauden es para medicinas de los niños del hospital.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía les cuenta a Celina y Vico que estuvo a punto de entregarse con Miguel, pero que Gastón casi los descubre. León sorprende a Diego y sus amigos intentando salir del colegio. Vico tiene dificultades con su padre. Jose sufre al ver a Raquel y Teo.

programme.title: Rebelde

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: La familia López se queda sin hogar por un incendio. A causa de la desgracia, deben remodelar y volver a empezar. La policía arresta a Plácido por comprar muebles robados.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido regresa a su casa después de haber sido arrestado por la compra de muebles robados. Gaby y Plutarco logran conseguir muebles para la casa, también de dudosa procedencia.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido está preocupado a causa del desbalance económico que han sufrido por el incendio. Durante una reunión familiar, Plácido establece nuevas reglas y les exige a todos conseguir un trabajo.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: El administrador del edificio notifica a la familia López la venta del edificio donde viven, por lo que deben desalojar el departamento en menos de 24 horas, ya que un nuevo supermercado será construido ahí.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: La familia López es notificada de que se les cortará el servicio del agua en su departamento. Los miembros de la familia intentan averiguar quién es el responsable de que les hayan retirado el servicio del agua.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido expresa ante su familia su sentir acerca de la falta de intimidad que existe en su hogar. La nueva dinámica para poder vivir en casa de los López es aportar dinero, de lo contrario deben tomar su turno para poder residir ahí.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: La familia López se reúne con Tecla para que confiese la verdad sobre su embarazo. Tecla admite que lo hizo porque le gustó y reitera que lo volvería hacer. Tecla confiesa que fue con Adolfo y que fueron tres veces.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido se preocupa por una llamada de Don Justo y le expresa a su familia que tendrá una reunión con su jefe. Don Justo va a nombrar socio a quien le tenga su café caliente.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Se va la luz en el apartamento de la familia López y comienzan a suceder cosas extrañas. Tecla es confundida con un fantasma. Don Arnoldo se da cuenta de que, mientras se fue la luz, han desaparecido sus tamales.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido y Plutarco se muestran muy contentos ante su familia y explican que Don Justo les ha dado sus primeras vacaciones pagadas. La familia López se organiza para salir juntos de paseo a Pepetongo.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Don Arnoldo, mientras duerme, menciona que tiene un tesoro en el pueblo de Apaseo el Grande, Guanajuato. La familia López implementa un plan para la búsqueda del tesoro.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido es despedido de su trabajo a causa de un incidente de Plutarco con Don Justo. Licha, mientras lee una revista, encuentra un artículo de la bruja Madame Patú, experta en la lectura de cartas.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido busca trabajo desesperadamente. El único trabajo que logra encontrar Plácido es vendiendo tamales. Justito invita a su abuelo materno a cenar a su casa. Tecla abandona a la familia López.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Licha fallece de manera inesperada y los López organizan un emotivo funeral, donde cumplen su última voluntad con sus cenizas. Llega alguien a la casa que amenaza con quedarse para siempre.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Los López deben tres meses de alquiler y la Chivis los amenaza con el desalojo si no le entregan el dinero en 24 horas. Por otra parte, Carlos, el padre de la Nena, ha regresado con la intención de quedarse.

programme.desc: Monique and coach Carl have been house hunting for five long years. Luckily, they don't have that kind of time, and with their lease up in only two months, it's time to get decisive.

programme.title: The Hard Word
programme.desc: Out of prison after serving time for armed robbery, brothers Dale (Guy Pearce), Mal (Damien Richardson) and Shane (Joel Edgerton) are set for a bank heist planned by their underhanded lawyer, Frank (Robert Taylor). But after pocketing his share of the cash, Frank, who's bedding Dale's wife (Rachel Griffiths), arranges to have them incarcerated again. Though he understands what his attorney is up to, Dale and his brothers agree to pull off a final robbery if Frank can get them freed once more.

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Delivery man Leo Jackson (Donald Faison) is definitely on the wrong road to success. He still lives at home, he and his girlfriend just broke up, and he has multiple complaints stacked against him at work. Fortunately, Leo has plenty of marijuana to keep his mind off his troubles. But when he accidentally delivers a box of cocaine to the wrong address, Leo finds himself in the middle of a bad deal that may just cost him his life.

programme.title: Montana
programme.desc: A crime boss pursues his girlfriend and two blackmailed gang members (Kyra Sedgwick, Stanley Tucci) trying to nab her.

programme.title: Stand Up Guys
programme.desc: After serving 28 years in prison for accidentally killing the son of a crime boss, newly paroled gangster Val (Al Pacino) reunites with his former partners in crime, Doc (Christopher Walken) and Hirsch (Alan Arkin), for a night on the town. As the three men revisit old haunts, reflect on their glory days and try to make up for lost time, one wrestles with a terrible quandary: Doc has orders to kill Val, and time is running out for him to figure out a way out of his dilemma.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: While battling a trio of rampaging giants, the legendary half-demon Hellboy encounters Nimue the Blood Queen, an ancient resurrected sorceress who's out to avenge a past betrayal. Suddenly caught in a clash between the supernatural and the human, Hellboy soon becomes hell-bent on stopping Nimue without triggering the end of the world.

programme.title: Dredd
programme.desc: Mega City One is a vast, violent metropolis where felons rule the streets. The only law lies with cops called "judges," who act as judge, jury and executioner, and Dredd (Karl Urban) is one of the city's most feared. One day, Dredd is partnered with Cassandra (Olivia Thirlby), a rookie with powerful psychic abilities. A report of a terrible crime sends Dredd and Cassandra to a dangerous area controlled by Ma-Ma (Lena Headey), a drug lord who will stop at nothing to protect her empire.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: Tough and chiseled Ray Breslin (Sylvester Stallone) knows how to infiltrate a prison -- and bust out of one. His latest job leads to a double-cross, leaving him stuck in a high-tech facility with the worst that society has to offer. Luckily for Ray, he meets Emil Rottmayer (Arnold Schwarzenegger), an inmate who secretly helps him hatch a plot to win his freedom. Only sadistic warden Hobbes (Jim Caviezel) stands in the way of the two men successfully making it out alive.

programme.title: Escape Plan 2: Hades
programme.desc: Ray Breslin manages an elite team of security specialists trained in the art of breaking people out of the world's most impenetrable prisons. When his trusted operative, Shu Ren, is kidnapped and disappears inside the most elaborate prison ever built, Ray assembles an elite team to assist in the rescue.

programme.title: Escape Plan: The Extractors
programme.desc: Ray Breslin and his team of security experts fight to rescue Breslin's girlfriend and a tech mogul's daughter from a formidable prison known as Devil's Station.

There, Jack and nine other prisoners learn they are to fight each other to the death, with freedom as the prize for the sole survivor. The producer plans to broadcast the event live and uncensored over the Internet.

programme.title: The Condemned 2
programme.desc: A former bounty hunter (Randy Orton) lands in a tournament where convicts fight to the death for an online audience.

programme.title: The Crazies
programme.desc: Anarchy reigns when an unknown toxin turns the peaceful citizens of Ogden Marsh into bloodthirsty lunatics. In an effort to contain the spread of the infection, authorities blockade the town and use deadly force to keep anyone from getting in or out. Now trapped among killers, Sheriff Dutton and his wife and two companions must band together to find a way out before madness and death overtake them.

programme.title: City of Lies
programme.desc: Los Angeles Police Department detective Russell Poole has spent years trying to solve his biggest case -- the murders of The Notorious B.I.G. and Tupac Shakur -- but after two decades, the investigation remains open. Jack Jackson, a reporter desperate to save his reputation and career, is determined to find out why. In search of the truth, the two team up and unravel a growing web of institutional corruption and lies.

programme.title: Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) works as a detective/psychologist for the Detroit Police Department along with his lifelong friend, Tommy Kane (Edward Burns), and detective Monica Ashe (Rachel Nichols). Cross' latest case puts him on a collision course with Picasso (Matthew Fox), a cunning serial killer whose ultimate target is multinational industrialist Giles Mercier (Jean Reno). Cross must find a way inside Picasso's head not only to catch the killer but also to stem the violent urges Cross feels.

programme.title: American Heist
programme.desc: Within 24 hours of being released from a 10-year sentence, Frankie (Adrien Brody) threatens to drag his brother James (Hayden Christensen) back into the criminal underworld that nearly swallowed them both years before.

programme.title: Traitor

All the clues in Clayton's investigation point to Samir Horn (Don Cheadle), a former Special Ops soldier who now aids terrorists. But as Clayton digs deeper and contradictory evidence begins to emerge, he begins to question Horn's motives.

programme.desc: Steve Harvey assumes the hosting duties for this daytime game show in which five members of one family are pitted against five members of another family. The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants.

programme.title: Match Game
programme.desc: Gene Rayburn hosts this comedy-game show hybrid in which contestants try to match answers given by celebrities to humorous, and often risque, fill-in-the-blank questions. The contestant with the most points at the end of the game advances to play the bonus round, in which the contestant has a chance to win thousands of dollars, with the actual amount dependent on the rules in place at the time of the episode.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: El pistolero fantasma
programme.desc: Un alguacil es asesinado por unos criminales en dos ocasiones, pero es reenviado a la Tierra para enfrentarlos.

programme.title: El bárbaro del ritmo
programme.desc: Un joven es elegido para tocar música cubana en una película y durante la filmación descubre sus propios talentos.

programme.title: Violaciones, casos de la vida real
programme.desc: Se designa a dos agentes, un hombre y una mujer, para capturar a una banda que aterroriza a las mujeres.

programme.title: El guerrillero de Chiapas
programme.desc: Dramatización del levantamiento, liderado por el Subcomandante Marcos, ocurrido en el estado de Chiapas en la década de 1990.

programme.title: Albures Mexicanos
programme.desc: Un grupo de bailarinas y cómicos se quedan sin teatro para sus presentaciones y se establecen en un terreno ajeno.

programme.title: Sucedió en México
programme.desc: Una mujer que planeaba suicidarse cambia de opinión y decide vivir e iniciar una nueva vida.

programme.title: Sexo y crimen
programme.desc: Un médico es extorsionado por el esposo de su amante para que firme una acta de defunción y ella pueda cobrar un seguro.

programme.title: Aventuras de un caballo blanco y un niño
programme.desc: Un niño y un caballo blanco son perseguidos por una banda de bandoleros, quienes quieren apoderarse de su oro escondido.

programme.title: Guantanamera
programme.desc: Una mujer viaja a Cuba y encuentra de nuevo a su viejo novio de la infancia, quien está casado con una mujer infiel.

programme.title: Las aventuras de Juliancito
programme.desc: Juliancito y su amigo están hartos del trato de sus papás, por lo que deciden irse a vivir a una isla y hacer creer a sus familias que están muertos para darles una lección.

programme.title: Los corrompidos
programme.desc: En un gran hotel hay de todo, una telefonista ninfómana, un recepcionista jugador y un elevadorista inescrupuloso.

programme.title: El Hombre sin Miedo
programme.desc: Un abogado americano cumple su amenaza de acabar con la familia de un hacendado cuando este le niega sus tierras.

programme.title: Morgana
programme.desc: El suicidio de una mujer demente a finales del siglo XIX tiene consecuencias terribles en la época actual. El miedo y el horror se apoderan especialmente de una jovencita en una pesadilla que parece llevarla directamente a su propia muerte.

programme.title: Tiempo de lobos
programme.desc: Los dos hijos de un campesino vuelven de trabajar como braceros y él les reprocha que no le ayuden en el campo.

programme.title: Mansión del Terror
programme.desc: Las extrañas vidas de dos personas son unidas por el amor, pero un mal recuerdo y algunos traumas transformaron todo en una cruel pesadilla.

programme.title: El Mofles en Acapulco
programme.desc: Dos bellas mujeres intentan seducir a un pobre empleado costero para que sea el receptor de un cargamento de droga.

programme.title: Mujeres de medianoche
programme.desc: Después de que una prostituta es asesinada, el novio de esta se entera de la doble vida que ella llevaba.

programme.title: Yako, Cazador de Malditos
programme.desc: Yako tiene que vengarse del hombre que asesinó a su esposa embarazada.

programme.title: Malverde, la leyenda
programme.desc: En el norte de México, un famoso bandolero se gana a la gente al repartir parte del producto de sus robos entre la población.

programme.title: El Hechizo del Pantano
programme.desc: Un niño juega en el bosque con una chiquilla y cuando su padre se entera descubren que ella murió años atrás.

programme.title: El tesoro del amazonas
programme.desc: Un aventurero y sus amigos compiten contra un ex-nazi y otras personas que buscan un tesoro de diamantes en la selva sudamericana.

programme.title: La historia de un gángster
programme.desc: La historia de un delincuente que sale de prisión antes de tiempo por buena conducta, pero este vuelve a meterse en problemas y retoma la vida criminal.

programme.title: La piel de la muerte
programme.desc: Dos mujeres huérfanas protegen un tesoro escondido al que todo el mundo anda buscando en el desierto.

programme.title: Los desalmados
programme.desc: Dos cazarrecompensas se convierten en fieles y buenos amigos, a pesar de los problemas debido a sus profesiones.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Europe's heating up: So where is the AC?
programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.

We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.

One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI.\n#SummerDavos2026.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film \"Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon\".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from \"word candy\" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game \"Sifu\" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to \"eat porridge at night\.

programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. In this episode of China Popcast, we tell you which maps to use, how to pay for things, offer advice on how to book tickets for major attractions, share information on China's current travel visa policies and more. Our guests Chen Hongpeng, a Beijing-based tour guide, and CGTN China Travel host Jack Klumpp join the show to give you expert tips for your China trip this summer. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the \"dos and don'ts.\.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: \"Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder.\nThough he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden’s journey as we explore his life in rural China.\.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Nature’s Bounty
programme.desc: In this episode, we start from hiking up volcanoes in Datong. There is a large volcanic cluster with over 30 cones. Then we come to the Hanging Temple – a 1,500-year-old monastery clutching at a cliff of Mount Hengshan. Join us for an adrenaline-pumping adventure.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: A Magic Chinese New Year
programme.desc: During the Year‑of‑the‑Ox Spring Festival, we visited Gubei Water Town in Miyun District, Beijing. Join host He Tianran to experience an authentic northern‑style Spring Festival. We will paste paper lanterns, cut paper‑cut window decorations, watch sugar‑blowing craftsmanship and release sky lanterns. Let us embrace this blessed Year of the Ox together.

programme.title: Wild Wonders Ep.4
programme.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique \"rock rhyme\" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: The Dynasty of Oracle Bones Ep.3
programme.desc: Over 3000 years ago, inscriptions were made into the bones of oxen and the undersides of turtle shells for the purpose of divination. Broken down into six comprehensive episodes, this series will enlighten you on the Shang Dynasty when they first appeared, as well as their role in the formation of Chinese writing.

programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: It's the Friday after Thanksgiving, and Chewed Up is all about transforming leftovers into brand-new masterpieces. Carla Hall whips up a decadent Ice Cream Pecan Pie using leftover pie slices, while Michael Symon cooks a savory Stuffing Frittata. The hosts confess their favorite late-night leftover habits, debate mayonnaise brands, and share wild stories about flying with pets.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: On this holiday-themed episode of Chewed Up Show, Michael Symon demonstrates how to elevate a classic holiday ham using POP MUSTARD's new maple bourbon glaze. He shares techniques for scoring the ham, basting it during cooking at low temperature, and finishing it at high heat for texture. The hosts discuss beloved holiday dishes and why certain seasonal foods deserve year-round attention. In a fun segment, Clinton Kelly and Carla Hall play a game selecting dream dinner guests from curated options, ultimately inviting Ina Garten, Dolly Parton, Bobby Flay, Buddy the Elf, Taylor Swift, and Shaquille O'Neal to their table. Fan mail rounds out the episode with discussions of favorite dishes from each host.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: In this Friendsgiving-focused episode, Clinton Kelly, Carla Hall, and Michael Symon clarify the nuances of bringing holiday dishes to gatherings. Carla demonstrates her Apple Butter–Pecan Biscuit Rolls, a soft, buttery biscuit dough rolled with spiced apple butter and topped with pecans. The recipe draws inspiration from Carla's pandemic stay in Charlotte, where locals introduced her to 'stickies'—biscuit-based cinnamon rolls. The hosts discuss the benefits of soft fats like shortening in biscuit dough, proper dough folding techniques, and why these rolls are superior to traditional yeast-based cinnamon rolls. They debate whether cold-weather entertaining favors hot or room-temperature dishes and play a game about bringing appropriate foods to life's major moments.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: The Chewed Up team conducts blind tastings of five store-bought gravies and four cranberry sauces, rating each on flavor, texture, and overall quality. Michael Symon, Clinton Kelly, and Carla Hall discover that Campbell's gravy delivers nostalgic diner-style comfort, while Signature Select turkey gravy ranks highest despite needing extra seasoning. For cranberry sauce, Ocean Spray jelly emerges as the clear winner over chunky varieties and an underseasoned homemade version. The hosts share kitchen must-haves for Thanksgiving: a quality instant-read thermometer, roasting pan with rack, and sharp chef's knife. They also discuss how store-bought options can work with simple tweaks like added salt, fresh herbs, or turkey drippings.

programme.title: Higgins Ridge
programme.desc: The incredible story of 20 elite firefighters (smokejumpers) who parachuted into the Idaho wilderness to put out a wildfire burning on a mountain ridge. What looked like a routine fire from the air became a different story on the ground, as wind fueled the blaze into a blowup. The smokejumpers, many in their first season on the job, pivoted from battling the fire to fighting for their lives as the fire surrounded them. Instinctively wanting to run to safety, they remembered the fate of 13 firefighters who unsuccessfully tried to outrun a fire in Montana's Mann Gulch 12 years earlier. With that tragedy in mind, the smokejumpers made the call to shelter in place. Skilled backcountry pilot Rod Snider set out to find them in a helicopter, with treacherous conditions due to the wind, and a lack of visibility due to the smoke. Now in his 90s, Snider revisits the unimaginable saga seared into his memory, revealing a story about bravery and brotherhood.

programme.title: Grandpa's War Story Goes Viral
programme.desc: For Alaskan teenager Henry De Hoop, social media platforms such as Facebook have provided a unique opportunity to share the World War II story of his grandfather, James (Jim) Schmidt, with a global audience. Narrated by Liev Schreiber, GRANDPAS WAR STORY GOES VIRAL shares the remarkable account of Jims World War II service and military career, as well as Henrys efforts to generate interest in his grandfathers war journey and launch a letter-writing campaign on his behalf.Like 16 million others of his generation, Jim responded to the national call to duty following the bombing of Pearl Harbor in 1941. The twist in the story? Jim was only 14 when he enlisted, and the eighth-grade Californian left home without telling his parents. After being wounded in the invasion of Sicily, Jims age was eventually revealed and he was sent home. Not to be deterred, Jim would do stints in both the U.S. Navy and Merchant Marines before finally reaching 18 and officially rejoining the Army. Grandson Henry marveled that Jim joined the war effort at the same age he was when he first shared Jim's story on social media.GRANDPAS WAR JOURNEY GOES VIRAL charts a story of service that began in a movie theater in 1942 where the film Parachute Battalion grabbed a boys attention and ends in the jungles of Vietnam more than two decades later.

programme.title: Broadside
programme.desc: Reduce that people to an entire submission.Charles II. August 28, 1664: The daily business of the Dutch settlement on Manhattan, New Amsterdam, comes to an abrupt halt as four English warships appear in the lower bay. Peter Stuyvesant, the colonys Director General, shores up defenses of the fort while sending a polite welcome to the Commander of the English squadron, Richard Nicolls. Nicolls has been sent by King Charles II to Reduce that people to an entire submission to us and secure that tradewhich the Dutch have wrongfully possessed themselves. He demands Stuyvesant and the town rendered to his majestys obedience, and protection. and has 96 cannons and three companies of troops to affect his orders. Stuyvesant, beset by decades of neglected defenses and the refusal of his own people to fight, surrenders without firing a shot. New Amsterdam becomes New Yorkfor nowas Charles provokes an all out war with the Dutch.

programme.title: Broadside
programme.desc: De Witt Meddles; God punishes London for Holmes Bonfire. Dutch are perhaps overconfident after the 4 Days Battle. But on Saint James Day they have fewer ships than the English (72 vs. 87) and, as usual, less firepower per ship. Moreover, unwisely, De Witt aligns his fleet to minimize the damage to certain flagships, which results in a cannon-duel favoring the English. De Witts meddling causes the Dutch to get much the worst of this battle. Blasting away for days in June and July, neither side can decisively follow up its victory. Tens of thousands killed, the wealth of both nations reduced to flotsam on the North Sea, and unspeakable hardships for each country...for what? Dutch privateers interdict coal bargesit will be very cold in London this winter. And, the Dutch are about to have a visit from Robert Holmes. Holmes gets a tip from a pusillanimous Dutchman about a large merchant fleet near the island of Terschelling. Holmes attacks, destroys one hundred fifty ships, and, to get his troops who are rampantly pillaging back on their ships, burns down Terschelling. Holmes Bonfire is a dangerous escalation of a horrific war. And, when the city of London burns to the ground a month later, many of the Dutch Elect see it as a work of God. Moreover, one Dutchman, Johan De Witt, plans to carry the war to the heart of England.

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: Why did ancient Roman rich famous choose to vacation here? Who opened the gate for the bad guys in the 1500s? What does the town clock tower symbolize? What's the history of majolica tile art? Why are Sorrento lemons and limoncello so famous?

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: What did Alfred Nobel invent that led him to create the Nobel Prize? What is Gamla Stan? What's so important about the throne inside the Royal Palace of Stockholm? What is the Djurgrden Canal, and why was it only for the Royal Family? Why did the Swedes grow grass on their rooftops, and what's the history of their folk costumes?

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: Why did the famous French architect Viollet-le-Duc only work on one residence: the historic Roquetaillade Castle? Why is there a monolithic church in St. Emilion? And why did its monk sleep underground? Why is there a giant wall around the tiny village of Blaye? And why was beautiful Bourg-en-Gironde built into the side of a cliff? And how do Cadillac and Pauillac make time stand still?

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: How did Dublin get its name? And what do Vikings and a black pool have to do with it? Who was Maewyn Succat, and why is he celebrated with green beer? How did the harp become a symbol of Ireland, and why do the harps on Irish coins and Guinness beer look different? What is the curious history of the Book of Kells, and how did it make its way into Trinity Colleges Longroom Library?

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: Who were the Habsburgs, Maria Theresa, Franz Joseph and Sisi? And how did they shape Vienna? What is the Ringstrasse, and why are there so many oversized, ornate public buildings dotting it? Where did Mozart perform as a 6-year-old prodigy? When and why did Austria shrink to a tenth of its size? What do the eagles on the rooftop of St. Stephens Cathedral symbolize? And why are Viennas coffee and pastries so legendary?

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: This beautiful region of England is full of picture-perfect rolling hills, quaint stone cottages, sprawling country estates and that distinct Yorkshire dialect. Why are country estates named Castles and Abbeys? What is The Shambles, and how did it get its name? Why is one of the largest medieval Gothic cathedrals in Europe in the small town of York? How did the Quakers and chocolate shape Yorks history? Where and what is Herriots country?

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: Why is there a giant church complex, the DomQuartier, in this tiny Alpine town? And why is there an equally giant medieval fortress high above it? Who lived in Mirabell Palace? And Hellbrun Palace? Why is Getreidegassse so charming, and why are those shop signs so important? And how do you solve a problem like Maria? From the Sound of Music to Silent Night to the Sonatas of this towns beloved Mozart, its time to get curious about Salzburg.

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: How did this UNESCO town in Mexico get such a curious name? And what do a duck and a dog have to do with it? Why are there so many grand mansions in such a small town? Why do postcards have to do with its soaring Gothic church? Why is there an art school in a former convent? And how did San Miguel de Allende become a magnet for retired American military on the G.I. Bill?

programme.title: Volle Girlpower? Shania Geiss kommt an ihr Limit!
programme.desc: Davina und Shania Geiss sollen endlich Hand anlegen und in Papas Fußstapfen treten. Eine riesige Kunst-Lieferung aus Bali muss angenommen werden – doch das läuft etwas anders als geplant... (S23 E32)

programme.title: Mega-Fail in Monaco: Bierdusche für Carmen Geiss!
programme.desc: Formel-1-Wochenende in Monaco, und natürlich wird nichts dem Zufall überlassen! Von der Luxus-Terrasse bis zum Sternekoch - hier wurde an alles gedacht! Doch plötzlich passiert's: Carmen Geiss kriegt unfreiwillig eine "Bierdusche" ab! (S3 E18)

programme.title: Letzter Stopp: San Francisco! Nachts allein in
programme.desc: In San Francisco angekommen, erkunden Robert und Carmen Geiss die Golden Gate Bridge! Als Abschluss ihrer USA-Reise gibt es noch eine private Führung im berühmtesten Gefängnis der Welt: Alcatraz! Allerdings kriegt Carmen richtig Muffensausen.. (S3 E19)

programme.title: Ohne Fleiß
programme.sub-title: kein Preis: Carmen Geiss' Kampf gegen
programme.desc: Carmen Geiss hat ihr Ziel vor Augen: Fünf Kilo abnehmen. Nach anderthalb Stunden Workout ist die ehemalige Miss Fitness auch fix und fertig - aber glücklich! (S3 E20)

programme.title: Ein Rennen gegen die Zeit: Speed-Shopping in Cannes!
programme.desc: Kaum in Cannes angekommen, beginnt Carmen Geiss mit ihrer Jagd nach Schuhen! Immerhin gibt es im Ausverkauf satte 50 Prozent Rabatt! Da muss sie einfach zuschlagen! (S4 E01)

programme.title: Ciao Milano! Familie Geiss auf Erkundungstour...
programme.desc: Die Geissens erkunden Mailand, vom Dom bis zur Leonardo-Statue. Carmen führt die Familie, während die kranke Davina mit den Großeltern ins Hotel zurückkehrt. Shania genießt die Zeit mit den Eltern, inklusive Juwelierbesuch. (S4 E02)

programme.title: Ganz nach Carmens Geschmack: Sixpack-Alarm in Miami!
programme.desc: Hot, hotter, South Beach! Hier jagt ein heißer Sixpack den nächsten! Carmen Geiss kommt aus dem Staunen gar nicht mehr heraus! Die "Beach Boys" haben es ihr so richtig angetan. (S4 E04)

programme.title: "Rakete auf dem Wasser!" Action-Urlaub in Miami...
programme.desc: Jetzt geht es mit Vollspeed über Miamis Küstengewässer. Doch nicht jedem gefallen 150 km/h so gut wie Robert Geiss… Denn Ehefrau Carmen bekommt Panik. (S4 E05)

programme.title: Carmen Geiss sieht Rot! Schluss mit Camping?!
programme.desc: Robert Geiss will Action, also sollen Carmen und Töchterchen Shania mit ihm Hovercraft fahren. Leider ist das Fahrzeug ROT. Da bekommt Frau Geiss direkt Schnappatmung, denn eine Wahrsagerin hat ihr das Ende in einem ROTEN Fahrzeug prophezeit... (S4 E07)

programme.title: Splish, Splash! Wasserspaß auf Privatinsel!
programme.desc: Inselbesichtigung deluxe! Gehört diese Privatinsel bald Robert? Sein Nachbar aus Monaco hat ihm die Insel einen Tag zur "Besichtigung" überlassen – ein echtes Privileg! Die Geissens genießen die Insel ganz für sich allein. (S4 E09)

programme.title: Mean Girls Shame Teen for Anime Cosplay
programme.desc: Popular Emily hides her anime cosplay passion until nerd Jackson discovers her secret. After being betrayed by her "cool" friends, she embraces her true self to win prom queen in full cosplay style.

programme.title: Girl in Witness Protection Held Hostage
programme.desc: Whistleblower Jennifer and her family enter witness protection. After facing threats and kidnapping by her corrupt CEO, they unite to expose his crimes and win justice for sick workers.

programme.title: Daycare Calls Child Services on Poor Mom
programme.desc: Single mom Carmen is fired for bringing her son to work at a hotel. After a daycare dispute leads to a CPS visit, the hotel's undercover owner saves her family and promotes her to manager.

programme.title: Vegan Teacher Bans All Meat on Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Ms. Klemper, a militant vegan teacher, rigs a school vote to ban meat following her brother's death. After her extreme methods cause a riot, she learns that forced change only breeds resentment.

programme.title: In-Laws Ruin Their Family Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Trapped by a blizzard, feuding moms Judy and Nana turn Thanksgiving into a war zone, nearly driving Jenna and Roger to divorce. Realizing they've gone too far, the matriarchs put aside their differences to cook a reconciliation feast and save the family.

programme.title: Girl Can't See Family on Thanksgiving
programme.desc: After job loss and a grounded flight ruin her Puerto Rican Thanksgiving plans, Analeese launches a DIY business with friends' help. They surprise her with a home-cooked feast and family FaceTime.

programme.title: Poor Sisters Not Allowed To Eat
programme.desc: The sudden death of their mother leaves Laura and Ana and their father, Miguel, struggling with grief and poverty. For Thanksgiving, the girls secretly salvage their dad's ruined dinner, reminding him that family makes it work, catching the attention of a wealthy party host.

programme.title: Fighting Siblings Ruin Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Siblings Randle and Jessie drop the turkey in a mop bucket and steal a replacement from a lady at the store. Their cover is blown when the victim arrives at dinner as their dad's secretary.

programme.title: Neighbors Won't Stop Fighting
programme.desc: Rival mothers Cecilia and Elizabeth engage in a relentless feud of one-upmanship, forcing their kids, Josh and Hazel, to sneak around to date. Exposed at a school formal, the moms' rivalry unravels, revealing their mutual insecurities and paving the way for reconciliation.

programme.title: Two Moms Fight Over Sale
programme.desc: Workaholic mom Rosa and neglectful mom Linda both believe a new TV will solve their family problems. Meeting a therapist who lost his daughter due to work stress, they realize the value of family time and change their priorities.

programme.title: Foster Mom Locks Up Food
programme.desc: Neglected foster child Andrew longs for a family. His foster siblings, Derek and Erica, track down his birth mom using a DNA kit and a viral TikTok video, reuniting the mother and son for Christmas.

programme.title: Rich Kid Has Everything Except One Thing
programme.desc: Wealthy, lonely Aiden struggles at a low-income school where peers resent his father's AI factory. After failing to buy friends, Aiden's secret kindness helps Emily's family. His father finally chooses family over profit, replacing AI with workers and reuniting with his son.

programme.title: Rich Mean Girl Forced To Live With Poor Student
programme.desc: Wealthy Ava bullies Penny over a cockroach but is forced to live with her for a school project. Discovering her parents' factory disabled Penny's mom, Ava secures them a settlement and finds true friendship.

programme.title: Hidden Cameras Expose Daycare's Huge Secret
programme.desc: Owners of an abusive daycare center neglect and starve non-verbal children while scamming for state grants. Using his grandmother's Ring camera app, Charlie exposes the truth, leading to their arrest.

programme.desc: Wissenschaftler wagen sich in die letzten Primärwälder Europas, tief in den albanischen Alpen. Dort suchen sie nach Antworten auf den Klimawandel und dokumentieren ein einzigartiges Ökosystem. Eine Expedition zu Europas wilden Wurzeln.

programme.title: Schweizer Flussgeschichten
programme.desc: Die Rhône – wasserreichster Strom der Schweiz – entspringt am Rhonegletscher und schlängelt sich durch das Wallis bis ins Mittelmeer. Filmemacherin Anja Glücklich erkundet auf ihrer Reise atemberaubende Landschaften, bedrohte Gletscher, wilde Flussabschnitte und die Menschen, die im Einklang mit der Natur leben. Vom Biologen im Pfynwald bis zur Winzerin im Tal: Alle eint der Wunsch, die Rhône und ihre einzigartige Artenvielfalt zu bewahren. Ein filmischer Streifzug durch ein faszinierendes Stück Schweiz, das Rilke einst zu poetischen Höhen inspirierte.

programme.title: Mein leckerer Garten
programme.desc: Den Auftakt der dritten Staffel macht Landfrau Rita Vitt aus Biberach-Prinzbach in der Ortenau. Sie bewirtschaftet einen 200 Quadratmeter großen Bauerngarten und baut alte Gemüsesorten an. Als kreative Brennmeisterin fängt sie die Aromen ihres Gartens auch in Bränden und Likören ein.

programme.title: Wohnen in Deutschland
programme.sub-title: Das Experiment auf der grünen Wiese
programme.desc: Berlin, Hamburg, Köln und an der Spitze München: In Deutschlands Metropolen steigen die Mieten auf Rekordniveau. Mittlerweile sorgt sich selbst die Mittelschicht, denn auch für Besserverdiener ist Wohnraum zum Luxusgut geworden. Doch die Not macht erfinderisch: Ob als Hauswächter in einem leer stehenden Krankenhaus oder alternative Dorfgenossenschaft, im innovativen Mehrgenerationen-Haus, einem gläsernen Gewächshaus oder im Wohnwagen auf dem Campingplatz - immer mehr Menschen suchen mit unkonventionellen Ideen nach Alternativen für ein neues, günstiges Zuhause. SPIEGEL TV hinterfragt den aktuellen "Immobilienwahnsinn", stellt außergewöhnliche Wohn-Projekte vor und besucht kreative Mieter. Wohnen in Deutschland - eine neue Serie bei SPIEGEL TV Wissen. Episodentext: Es ist ein gesellschaftliches Experiment: In der süddeutschen Provinz im Dorf Tempelhof leben 120 Ex-Städter in einer Art schwäbischem Hightech-Kibbuz zusammen. Umgeben von 26 Hektar landwirtschaftlicher Nutzfläche versorgen sich die Bewohner fast autark. Es gibt eine Käserei, eine Bäckerei, eine Imkerei, eine Schneiderei, eine Fahrradwerkstatt - und neben dem Waldkindergarten bald auch eine eigene Schule. Doch der Wunsch in großer Gemeinschaft zu leben, läuft nicht immer zwangsläufig harmonisch ab. Weil alle mitbestimmen dürfen, sind Konflikte vorprogrammiert. Jeden Tag aufs Neue versuchen die Kibbuz-Mitglieder auf dem Tempelhof den Spagat zwischen modernem Arbeitsplatz in der Stadt und einem alternativen Leben in der idyllischen Natur zu vereinbaren.

programme.title: Fate/kaleid liner PRISMA ILLYA
programme.desc: Illya und ihre Freunde stecken eine herbe Niederlage gegen Caster ein. Nun müssen sie versuchen ihr Teamwork zu verbessern, um im nächsten Kampf den Sieg erringen zu können.

programme.title: Fate/kaleid liner PRISMA ILLYA
programme.desc: Illya und Miyu bleibt keine Zeit, sich über ihren schwer erarbeiteten Sieg zu freuen, da überraschenderweise die Class Card Saber erscheint und Rin und Luvia außer Gefecht setzt.

programme.title: Fate/kaleid liner PRISMA ILLYA
programme.desc: Illya muss auf die Kraft der Class Card Archer zugreifen, um im Kampf gegen Saber auch nur den Hauch einer Chance zu haben.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412: ERWACHSENENZAUBER
programme.desc: In der Oberschule von Kaito und Aoko soll es angeblich spuken. Aoko schleppt Kaito mit, um der Sache auf den Grund zu gehen. Nach einigen gruseligen Vorkommnissen scheint Kaito den Geist enttarnt zu haben…

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Der Startschuss für das Rennen zum Todoroki-Schrein ist gefallen, doch Idate rennt nicht, wie erwartet, zum Hafen, sondern schlägt den Weg in den Wald ein. Naruto, Sakura und Sasuke verfolgen ihn und holen ihn irgendwann ein. Idate erklärt ihnen, dass er zum Hafen im Norden will, weil von dort aus die Strömung zu der Insel, die sie als erste Etappe erreichen müssen, günstiger ist. Sie besteigen ein Schiff, doch Oboro und seine Helfer sind ihnen auf den Fersen, um sie zu sabotieren. Es kommt zu einem Kampf auf dem Meer, doch es gelingt den Freunden, von Bord zu kommen

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Idate hat es geschafft, sich an Land zu retten, nachdem ein paar von Fukusukes Schergen das Boot der Freunde angegriffen hatten. Doch am Ufer wartet ein größeres Problem auf ihn: Aoi. Sein Erzfeind, der Idate damals ausgetrickst hat. Idate hat Konoha hintergangen, ohne es anfänglich zu wissen und als er den Trick durchschaut hatte, war es zu spät. Im Kampf mit Aoi wird Idate durch giftige Nadeln verletzt und kann sich nicht mehr bewegen. Damit scheint das Rennen zum Todoroki-Schrein für ihn gelaufen zu sein. Doch dann tauchen Naruto und Co. wieder auf und die Dinge ändern sich. Idate fasst wieder Mut.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Shippuden: Folge dem Schatten deines Lehrers
programme.desc: Auf Naruto wartet bei seiner Rückkehr nach Konoha eine schlimme Nachricht. Tsunade muss ihm berichten, dass Jiraiya von seiner letzten Mission nicht zurückgekehrt ist. Naruto kann das Unglück gar nicht fassen und ist außer sich vor Wut und Trauer. Er zieht sich zurück, um all der schönen Momente mit seinem Sensei zu gedenken. Doch dann erfährt er von Fukasaku, dass ihm Jiraiya eine letzte verschlüsselte Botschaft hinterlassen hat. Was mag der wirre Zahlencode zu bedeuten haben…?

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Shikamaru versucht immer noch jemanden zu finden, der ihm Auskunft darüber geben kann, was der seltsame Zahlencode zu bedeuten hat, den Jiraiya als letzte Nachricht auf Fukasakus Rücken geschrieben hat. Weder Tsunade noch Kakashi können ihm da weiterhelfen, doch Naruto hat eine Idee. Die Ziffer, die aussieht wie eine neun, ist seiner Meinung nach das Schriftzeichen für „Ta“. Er hat es oft in den Manuskripten von Jiraiya gesehen. Mit dieser Info kommt die Dechiffrierungsexpertin Shiho ein ganzes Stück weiter, denn sie geht davon aus, dass die anderen Zahlen Seitenzahlten aus seinem letzten Buch sind. So setzt sie schließlich den Satz zusammen: „Der Richtige ist nicht unter ihnen.“ Doch damit kann zunächst auch niemand etwas anfangen. Derweil macht Fukasaku Naruto das Angebot, ihn in das Land der Kröten zu begleiten, um ihm das Jutsu der Weisen beizubringen. Natürlich sagt Naruto zu.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Shippuden: Der Weg zum Jutsu der Weisen
programme.desc: Naruto trainiert mit Fukamatsu, die Jutsus der Weisen zu beherrschen. Dabei stellt er sich erstaunlich geschickt an.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Fukasaku trainiert Naruto immer weiter, und ist ganz angetan von seinen Erfolgen, auch wenn es immer wieder Rückschläge gibt. Narutos Ziel, die Jutsus des Weisen zu beherrschen, rückt langsam aber sicher näher, auch wenn es ein beschwerlicher , Kraft raubender Weg ist. Fukasaku sieht Parallelen zwischen dem jungen Jiraya, den er auch trainiert hatte, und Naruto, was die Erfolge betrifft. Dabei war Jiraya besonders erfolgreich. Sollte Naruto das auch gelingen?

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto ist nach wie vor im Land der Kröten, um dort das Jutsu der Weisen zu lernen, doch Fukasaku bescheinigt ihm, dass er es nun ziemlich gut drauf hätte, macht ihn jedoch auch noch auf einige Risiken des Jutsus aufmerksam. Währenddessen plant Tendo, einer der Gestalten von Pain, den ultimativen Angriff auf Konoha. Es gelingt ihm und seinem Team, die Schutzbarrikade des Dorfes zu durchbrechen. Die Bevölkerung gerät in Panik und die Wachen sind völlig überfordert, denn es wurde nur ein Eindringling registriert, die Angriffe scheinen aber aus allen Richtungen zu kommen. Tsunade befiehlt, Naruto sofort zurück zu holen, denn sie ahnt, dass dies nun der lange befürchtete Angriff von Akatsuki ist.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Akatsuki hat begonnen, Konoha anzugreifen und es herrscht ein absolutes Chaos. Sakura übernimmt die Leitung des Krankenhauses. Derweil findet Shizune heraus, dass die Metallteile im Körper der Gestalt von Pain offenbar Chakra-Empfänger sind, doch auch Tsunade, der sie sofort Bericht erstattet, kann mit der Info noch nicht so viel anfangen. Dafür ruft sie erstmal ihren vertrauten Geist Katsuyu herbei, um die Medizin-Ninjas zu unterstützen. Naruto ist nach wie vor auf dem Berg Myoboku und weiß von alledem noch nichts…

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Kakashi befiehlt ihm mit letzter Kraft, sich auf den Weg zu Tsunade zu machen, um ihr die neuesten Informationen über das Jutus von Pain zu überbringen, damit sie eine Strategie entwickeln kann. Derweil versucht Sakura weiterhin, inzwischen mit Unterstützung von Katsuyu, die Verletzten zu versorgen, die der Angriff von Akatsuki nach sich gezogen hat.Kakashi hat Iruka mit einem Verletzten weggeschickt und steht nun allein Pain gegenüber. Zunächst schickt er einen seiner Blitzdoppelgänger in den Kampf, um herauszufinden, welche Fähigkeiten Pain hat. Dessen Jutsu scheint eine Art Schockwelle zu sein, innerhalb der Pain seine Zielobjekte an sich heranziehen oder weit wegstoßen kann, was es ihm ermöglicht, sämtliche Angriffe abzuwehren. Kakashi begreift, dass er allein keine Chance gegen diesen Gegner hat, der ja auch noch aus mehreren besteht. Doch er hat Glück. Chojis Vater und sein Team haben sich auf den Weg gemacht und sie unterstützen ihn. Dennoch gelingt es Pain allem Anschein nach, sämtliche Gegner zu besiegen, bis auf Choji.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto befindet sich nach wie vor auf dem Berg Myoboku und hat keine Ahnung, was sich in Konoha abspielt. Er fürchtet sich allerdings davor, dass Akatsuki dort eindringen wird, aber Fukasaku beruhigt ihn, indem er ihm erklärt, dass es in Konoha so viele hervorragende Ninjas gibt, dass die Organisation es nicht wagen wird. Wenn er nur wüsste… Pain und seine Gestalten marschieren unaufhaltsam voran und verursachen ein nie dagewesenes Chaos im Dorf. Niemand scheint sie stoppen zu können, denn die Ermittlungen, welche Fähigkeiten Pain eigentlich hat, laufen viel zu langsam voran, als dass sie für die Gegenwehr verwertbar wären.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Tsunade macht sich mit Shizune auf, um in einer Spielhalle ihr Glück zu suchen. Dort überschlagen sich die Ereignisse: Tsunade verspielt alles und verlangt von Shizune, ihren Koffer aus der Herberge zu holen. Aber da ist kein Geld, sondern es sind nur Schuldscheine drin. Zu guter Letzt wird Naruto auch noch eine Kette gestohlen, die er von Tsunade bekommen hatte. Und plötzlich finden Shizune und Naruto einen Erpresser-Brief von irgendwelchen Geldeintreibern. Nun ist Wachsamkeit geboten.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Lass das Ninja-Leben hinter dir – Tsunades Ankündigung
programme.desc: Tsunade soll in ihr neues Amt als Hokage eingeführt werden. Die Vorbereitungen laufen auf Hochtouren. Die meisten Bewohner von Konoha-Gakure sind voller Hoffnung und erwarten endlich mehr Sicherheit für das Dorf, es gibt aber auch Personen, die skeptisch sind, ob eine Frau dem so wichtigen Posten überhaupt gewachsen ist. Tsunade hat also alle Hände voll zu tun, um ihre Qualitäten zu beweisen. Als erstes versucht sie, Naruto einen dringenden Wunsch zu erfüllen. Sie versucht mit ihrer schier unglaublichen Kraft die Wunden von Sasuke, Kakashi und Lee zu heilen. Zumindest Letzterer muss aber einsehen, dass sein Weg als Shinobi zu Ende ist, weil die Verletzung zu stark und eine Operation nicht möglich ist. Sein Lehrer Guy ist verzweifelt.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Der Erbe des Willens des Feuers
programme.desc: Tsunade ist nicht überzeugt davon, ob ihr das Amt des Hokage in Konoha gefällt – es gibt keine Bars, keine Spielcasinos und als sie morgens ihr Büro betreten will, geht das nicht, weil Konohamaru sich dort verbarrikadiert hat. Naruto ist den ganzen Tag damit beschäftigt, ihn da rauszulocken, bis Konohamaru ihm endlich sagt, warum er sich dort eingeschlossen hat. Es war das Zimmer seines Großvaters und er will nicht, dass jemand anders es benutzt. Derweil beschäftigt sich Tsunade mit Lees Schicksal. Sie möchte ihm gern helfen gesund zu werden, weiß aber noch nicht wie

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Lee leidet sehr darunter, noch nicht wieder gesund zu sein und Tsunade hat ihm bei einer Operation eine höchstens 50 Prozentige Erfolgschance in Aussicht gestellt. Er erinnert sich an seine Anfänge als Ninja, wie er Guy das erste Mal begegnete und der dann zu seinem Trainer wurde… Tsunade versucht währenddessen eine Möglichkeit zu finden, Lee zu heilen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Das Geheimnis, das geheim bleiben wird ?
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke und Sakura haben sich in den Kopf gesetzt, endlich rauszufinden, was sich hinter dem Tuch von Kakashi verbirgt und warum er es wohl trägt. Sie stellen wilde Mutmaßungen an, ob er vielleicht Hasenzähne hat, dicke Lippen oder ähnliches und denken sich einen Plan aus, wie sie ihn dazu bewegen können, das Tuch endlich mal abzunehmen. Aber Kakashi riecht den Braten und so schlagen sämtliche Ideen fehl. Zwischendurch schlägt Kakashi sich noch mit einem etwas dämlichen Ninja-Trio herum, das sich für einen Vorfall von vor drei Jahren an ihm rächen will… Schließlich geht Naruto den direkten Weg und fragt Kakashi einfach, was unter seinem Tuch ist.

In der Tat öffnen sich bald für Gingka die Tore des Hades, und er und Pegasus werden von der Hölle verschluckt. Aber Gingka macht Damian klar, dass er nur eine Marionette ist, gegen die ein wahrer Blader niemals verlieren kann.

programme.desc: Die Siegesfeier von Gangan Galaxy erhält plötzlich unerwarteten Besuch: Ziggurat landet mit dem Team Star Breaker, den Garcias und Julian auf der Dachterrasse. Er hat aus den Beys und den besten Bladern eine Energie geholt, die er als "Spiralkraft" bezeichnet und die unvorstellbar gewaltig ist.

Während in der Wüste vor der Stadt ein heftiger Bey-Kampf tobt, trifft Ziggurat Vorbereitungen, mit der gesamten Stadt von der Erde abzuheben.

programme.title: Nicht Alles Verloren
